title: 噴射灌漿地盤改良~Jet-grouting ground improvement
focus: 噴射侵蝕、改良體連續性與水力驗證~Jet erosion, treated-ground continuity and hydraulic verification
summary: 噴射灌漿以高能流體侵蝕並混合原土，形成幾何與材料性質受地層控制的改良體。本課區分止水與承載需求，從滲流、咬合、材料留存及返漿量平衡出發，逐步檢查強度發展、複合地盤分力、鑽孔偏斜和統計變異，最後以水力試驗驗證整體功能。~Jet grouting erodes and mixes soil to form treated bodies whose geometry and properties depend on ground conditions. The course separates cutoff and bearing functions, linking seepage, overlap, binder retention and return balance to strength, composite-ground sharing, bore deviation and variability, then verifies overall performance hydraulically.

units.title: 改良體滲流的機理與驗證~Treated-ground seepage mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 改良體用於止水時，連續性與最弱路徑可能比試體抗壓強度更重要。均質達西模型可估平均流量，但施工接面、未改良夾層或縮頸會提供短路徑，平均滲透係數低並不能保證整個帷幕水密；驗收須同時涵蓋材料與幾何。達西式假設代表性均質與層流，不能描述開放缺口；流量低亦可能由水頭不足造成，試驗邊界必須記錄。~For a cutoff, continuity and the weakest path may matter more than specimen compressive strength. A homogeneous Darcy model estimates mean flow, but interfaces, untreated seams and necking create bypasses. Low average permeability therefore does not prove a sealed curtain; acceptance must address both material properties and geometry. Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、坡降i=2，Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and gradient i=2, Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 對照跨帷幕水頭與分區水量，配合取芯及施工位置圖，區分均質滲透和局部短路。設計應分列強度、滲透及連續性要求；地工設計者確認各項證據，不以單一試體結果替代整體驗證。~Compare heads across the curtain and zoned flows with cores and installation positions, distinguishing distributed permeability from local bypass paths. Specify strength, permeability and continuity separately; the geotechnical designer reviews each evidence stream rather than replacing system verification with one specimen result.
units.failure: 高強度試體可能來自完整區，而未取到的縮頸仍會漏水帶砂，使整體止水失效。達西式假設代表性均質與層流，不能描述開放缺口；流量低亦可能由水頭不足造成，試驗邊界必須記錄。~Strong specimens may come from intact zones while unsampled necks still leak and transport soil, defeating the overall cutoff. Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded.
units.misconception: 噴射改良體抗壓強度高就一定具有足夠止水能力。~High jet-grouted compressive strength guarantees adequate cutoff performance.
units.practice: 設計應分列強度、滲透及連續性要求；地工設計者確認各項證據，不以單一試體結果替代整體驗證。達西式假設代表性均質與層流，不能描述開放缺口；流量低亦可能由水頭不足造成，試驗邊界必須記錄。~Specify strength, permeability and continuity separately; the geotechnical designer reviews each evidence stream rather than replacing system verification with one specimen result. Darcy flow assumes representative homogeneous laminar behaviour and does not describe open gaps; low discharge can also result from insufficient test head, which must be recorded.

units.title: 柱體交疊的機理與驗證~Column overlap mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 噴射柱的直徑隨土種、設備反應與施工條件改變，設計中心距必須給直徑變異留出餘裕。相鄰柱在某個深度相交，不代表全深都連續；黏土團塊、礫石或夾層可能讓截面不圓，應以試驗柱與全深證據建立保守幾何。等直徑咬合式只描述理想平行圓柱，真實不規則截面需用最小有效尺寸；重疊也不自動證明接面黏結。~Jet-column diameter changes with soil, equipment response and execution conditions, so spacing must accommodate variability. Intersection at one depth does not establish full-depth continuity. Clay lumps, gravel and layering can create noncircular sections, requiring trial columns and full-depth evidence to define conservative geometry. Equal-diameter overlap describes ideal parallel cylinders only; irregular sections require minimum effective dimensions, and intersection does not automatically demonstrate interface bond.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設有效直徑D=1.5 m、中心距s=1.2 m，名目咬合o=D−s=0.3 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For effective diameter D=1.5 m and centre spacing s=1.2 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.3 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以試驗柱揭露或核定探測取得分層直徑，結合孔斜重建最小交疊，不只查柱頂。柱距及補柱決策須依最不利地層試驗；地工設計者核定幾何不確定度與驗證位置後才施工。~Obtain layered diameters from exposed trial columns or approved investigation, combining them with bore deviation to reconstruct minimum overlap beyond the column head. Spacing and supplementary columns follow trials in adverse strata; the geotechnical designer approves geometric uncertainty and verification locations before execution.
units.failure: 局部縮頸可能留下貫通水路，即使柱頂直徑達標也無法彌補深部未交疊。等直徑咬合式只描述理想平行圓柱，真實不規則截面需用最小有效尺寸；重疊也不自動證明接面黏結。~Local necking can leave a connected water path that adequate head diameter cannot compensate for. Equal-diameter overlap describes ideal parallel cylinders only; irregular sections require minimum effective dimensions, and intersection does not automatically demonstrate interface bond.
units.misconception: 每支柱頂直徑達標就能保證整個改良區無缺口。~Compliant diameter at every column head guarantees a gap-free treatment zone.
units.practice: 柱距及補柱決策須依最不利地層試驗；地工設計者核定幾何不確定度與驗證位置後才施工。等直徑咬合式只描述理想平行圓柱，真實不規則截面需用最小有效尺寸；重疊也不自動證明接面黏結。~Spacing and supplementary columns follow trials in adverse strata; the geotechnical designer approves geometric uncertainty and verification locations before execution. Equal-diameter overlap describes ideal parallel cylinders only; irregular sections require minimum effective dimensions, and intersection does not automatically demonstrate interface bond.

units.title: 膠結材料留存的機理與驗證~Binder retention mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 注入膠結材料有一部分隨返漿排出，另一部分留在地盤中參與固化，所以投入量不能直接當改良體配比。原土含水及返漿固體濃度會影響質量平衡，若只量體積而不量密度與成分，便無法合理判定實際留存量。此式假設能識別返出的同一膠結材料，未計側向漏失與未採樣流路；留存質量也不等於均勻混合程度。~Some injected binder leaves with returns while the remainder participates in ground solidification, so input quantity is not the treated-body mix ratio. Soil water and return solids affect the mass balance. Volume alone, without density and composition, cannot reliably establish how much binder remains in the ground. The expression assumes recovered binder can be identified and excludes lateral loss and unsampled paths; retained mass does not establish uniform mixing.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設注入乾膠結材Min=1000 kg、返漿帶出同材Mout=250 kg，留存Mret=Min−Mout=750 kg。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For injected dry binder Min=1000 kg and the same binder recovered in returns Mout=250 kg, retained Mret=750 kg. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 同步量注入與返漿體積、密度及代表性固體成分，明確區分原土固體與膠結材。質量表需註明取樣方法與成分不確定度；材料負責人及地工設計者共同解釋異常留存率後才調整方案。~Measure input and return volumes, densities and representative solids together, explicitly distinguishing native-soil solids from binder. The balance identifies sampling and composition uncertainty; materials and geotechnical leads interpret anomalous retention together before modifying the scheme.
units.failure: 將返漿全部固體當水泥或忽略返出損失，會錯估留存配比，造成強度預測與實測不符。此式假設能識別返出的同一膠結材料，未計側向漏失與未採樣流路；留存質量也不等於均勻混合程度。~Treating all return solids as cement or ignoring binder loss misstates retained mix and causes strength predictions to diverge from tests. The expression assumes recovered binder can be identified and excludes lateral loss and unsampled paths; retained mass does not establish uniform mixing.
units.misconception: 注入多少水泥就有多少水泥留在設計改良柱內。~All injected cement remains inside the intended treated column.
units.practice: 質量表需註明取樣方法與成分不確定度；材料負責人及地工設計者共同解釋異常留存率後才調整方案。此式假設能識別返出的同一膠結材料，未計側向漏失與未採樣流路；留存質量也不等於均勻混合程度。~The balance identifies sampling and composition uncertainty; materials and geotechnical leads interpret anomalous retention together before modifying the scheme. The expression assumes recovered binder can be identified and excludes lateral loss and unsampled paths; retained mass does not establish uniform mixing.

units.title: 直徑面積效應的機理與驗證~Diameter-area effect mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 改良柱直徑影響承載面積與交疊，但增大幾何尺寸不一定同比增加均勻強度區。噴射侵蝕受地層可侵蝕性控制，粗粒或高塑性夾層可讓外形及品質不同；方案比較應把幾何面積、材料性能與有效受力區分開列示。面積比只是幾何結果，沒有包含強度、端承、黏結或群效；有效容量仍需按實際失效模式與品質變異檢核。~Column diameter affects bearing area and overlap, but larger geometry does not necessarily enlarge the uniformly strong zone proportionally. Erodibility controls jet response, and coarse or highly plastic layers change shape and quality. Compare geometric area, material performance and effective loaded area separately in option studies. The ratio is geometric only and excludes strength, toe resistance, bond and group effects; usable capacity follows actual failure mechanisms and quality variability.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設圓截面直徑由D₁=1.0 m增至D₂=1.4 m，面積比A₂/A₁=(D₂/D₁)²=1.96。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For circular diameters D₁=1.0 m and D₂=1.4 m, area ratio A₂/A₁=(D₂/D₁)²=1.96. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以分層試驗柱尺寸與取芯均勻度比較不同方案，檢查增加面積是否位於實際受力或止水區。設計圖須區分名目直徑與有效改良直徑；地工設計者依試驗結果核定用於承載的範圍。~Compare layered trial-column dimensions and core uniformity, checking whether additional area lies within the actual bearing or cutoff zone. Distinguish nominal and effective treated diameters on drawings; the geotechnical designer approves the area credited for resistance from trial evidence.
units.failure: 用理想直徑放大容量可能忽略邊緣低強度區，造成受力集中與不均勻壓縮。面積比只是幾何結果，沒有包含強度、端承、黏結或群效；有效容量仍需按實際失效模式與品質變異檢核。~Scaling resistance by ideal diameter can overlook weak margins, concentrating load and producing differential compression. The ratio is geometric only and excludes strength, toe resistance, bond and group effects; usable capacity follows actual failure mechanisms and quality variability.
units.misconception: 直徑增加百分之四十，容量就必定增加百分之九十六。~A forty-percent diameter increase necessarily raises capacity by ninety-six percent.
units.practice: 設計圖須區分名目直徑與有效改良直徑；地工設計者依試驗結果核定用於承載的範圍。面積比只是幾何結果，沒有包含強度、端承、黏結或群效；有效容量仍需按實際失效模式與品質變異檢核。~Distinguish nominal and effective treated diameters on drawings; the geotechnical designer approves the area credited for resistance from trial evidence. The ratio is geometric only and excludes strength, toe resistance, bond and group effects; usable capacity follows actual failure mechanisms and quality variability.

units.title: 返漿體積平衡的機理與驗證~Return-volume balance mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 返漿提供注入流體及被侵蝕土粒離開地盤的路徑，返漿不足可能是滯留、堵塞或側向漏失，不能直接解釋為改良效率提高。體積差需連同密度、地表隆起及孔隙水壓判讀，才能分辨材料留存與不希望的地層位移。體積差不是純土體壓縮量，也不是乾膠結材質量；含水、氣泡、原土排出及量測延遲都可能影響此平衡。~Returns provide an exit for injected fluid and eroded soil. Reduced returns may indicate retention, blockage or lateral loss rather than improved treatment efficiency. Interpret volume differences with density, surface heave and pore pressure to distinguish useful material retention from undesirable displacement of the surrounding ground. Volume difference is neither pure soil compression nor dry binder mass; water, air, removed native soil and measurement delay all affect the balance.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設注入Vin=4 m³、量得返出Vout=3.2 m³，未平衡體積ΔV=0.8 m³。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For input Vin=4 m³ and measured returns Vout=3.2 m³, unbalanced volume ΔV=0.8 m³. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 同步記錄返漿量、孔壓與地表位移，追查取樣及儲槽延遲，避免把暫時管內容積當地下留存。返漿異常與隆起應有共同停留點；地工及施工負責人查明去向後，才核定後續施工條件。~Synchronize returns, pore pressure and surface movement, checking sampling and tank delays so that temporary pipe storage is not counted as subsurface retention. Provide a joint hold point for abnormal returns and heave; geotechnical and construction leads determine material destination before approving further work.
units.failure: 返漿通道阻塞可使地層隆起或漿液沿弱面外逸，鄰近管線可能在柱體強度形成前就受損。體積差不是純土體壓縮量，也不是乾膠結材質量；含水、氣泡、原土排出及量測延遲都可能影響此平衡。~Blocked returns can heave ground or force grout along weak planes, damaging nearby utilities before column strength develops. Volume difference is neither pure soil compression nor dry binder mass; water, air, removed native soil and measurement delay all affect the balance.
units.misconception: 返漿越少代表水泥留得越多，所以一定更好。~Less return means more retained cement and is therefore always better.
units.practice: 返漿異常與隆起應有共同停留點；地工及施工負責人查明去向後，才核定後續施工條件。體積差不是純土體壓縮量，也不是乾膠結材質量；含水、氣泡、原土排出及量測延遲都可能影響此平衡。~Provide a joint hold point for abnormal returns and heave; geotechnical and construction leads determine material destination before approving further work. Volume difference is neither pure soil compression nor dry binder mass; water, air, removed native soil and measurement delay all affect the balance.

units.title: 強度齡期發展的機理與驗證~Strength development mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 水泥土強度隨齡期及養護條件增加，但土體有機物、含水量與混合均勻度可能限制反應。早期強度與後期強度比例可比較材料發展，卻不能把單一比值套到所有土層；現場芯樣的擾動與尺寸也需和室內試體區分。強度比不是長期耐久或水密證明，且必須使用可比較的試體與試驗方法；不同養護條件不得直接合併。~Soil-cement strength develops with age and curing, but organic content, water and mixing uniformity can limit reactions. An early-to-late strength ratio compares development but is not universal across strata. Disturbance and dimensions of field cores must also be distinguished from laboratory specimens when interpreting the apparent gain. The ratio proves neither durability nor sealing and requires comparable specimens and methods; incompatible curing conditions must not be pooled directly.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設同類試體早期qu₁=1.2 MPa、後期qu₂=2.4 MPa，強度比qu₂/qu₁=2.0。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For comparable specimens with early qu₁=1.2 MPa and later qu₂=2.4 MPa, strength ratio qu₂/qu₁=2.0. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 依地層與齡期分組試驗，保留養護溫度、尺寸與破壞型態，檢查現場取芯是否代表弱區。試驗計畫應預先處理取芯失敗與異常低值；材料及地工設計者共同判讀，不能任意刪除不利資料。~Group tests by stratum and age, retaining curing temperature, specimen dimensions and failure mode, and check whether field cores represent weak zones. The testing plan defines treatment of core loss and low results in advance; materials and geotechnical designers interpret them without arbitrary removal of adverse data.
units.failure: 只挑完整芯樣會高估強度，未成芯區若被排除，最薄弱的改良體可能完全沒有進入統計。強度比不是長期耐久或水密證明，且必須使用可比較的試體與試驗方法；不同養護條件不得直接合併。~Selecting only intact cores inflates strength; excluding uncoreable intervals can remove the weakest treated ground from the statistics entirely. The ratio proves neither durability nor sealing and requires comparable specimens and methods; incompatible curing conditions must not be pooled directly.
units.misconception: 後期平均強度加倍，就代表所有位置都同樣加倍。~A doubled later mean strength means every location doubled equally.
units.practice: 試驗計畫應預先處理取芯失敗與異常低值；材料及地工設計者共同判讀，不能任意刪除不利資料。強度比不是長期耐久或水密證明，且必須使用可比較的試體與試驗方法；不同養護條件不得直接合併。~The testing plan defines treatment of core loss and low results in advance; materials and geotechnical designers interpret them without arbitrary removal of adverse data. The ratio proves neither durability nor sealing and requires comparable specimens and methods; incompatible curing conditions must not be pooled directly.

units.title: 複合地盤分力的機理與驗證~Composite-ground sharing mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 改良柱與周圍原土共同承受上部荷載，剛度較高的柱往往承擔較高應力。等應變模型可推導柱土應力比，但需有足夠剛性上部荷載分配層；柔性載重、局部沉陷與柱端條件會使真實分力偏離簡化模型。式中n是相應應變下的剛度比，不是抗壓強度比；柱體承載、原土剪力與整體沉陷仍須分別檢查。~Treated columns and native soil share load, with stiffer columns generally carrying greater stress. Equal-strain analysis derives a column-soil stress ratio but requires sufficiently rigid load distribution. Flexible loading, local settlement and toe conditions can produce sharing that differs substantially from the simplified relation. Here n is a stiffness ratio at corresponding strain, not a strength ratio; column resistance, native-soil shear and overall settlement still require separate checks.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設平均q=100 kPa、面積比a=0.3、柱土剛度比n=5且等應變，σc=q/[a+(1−a)/n]=227 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For mean q=100 kPa, area ratio a=0.3 and stiffness ratio n=5 under equal strain, σc=q/[a+(1−a)/n]=227 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 量測柱頂及土間壓力與沉陷，核對荷載分配層剛度，使用相同荷載範圍的柱土模數。設計者應明確標示等應變假設與負載轉移層；試驗不支持此假設時，需改用符合實際邊界的互制分析。~Measure column-head and intervening-soil pressures with settlement, check load-transfer-layer stiffness, and use moduli from matching load ranges. The designer states equal-strain and load-transfer-layer assumptions; if measurements do not support them, use an interaction model consistent with actual boundaries.
units.failure: 只把平均載重當柱應力會低估柱體需求，局部破壞後荷載又轉到鄰柱並擴大差異沉陷。式中n是相應應變下的剛度比，不是抗壓強度比；柱體承載、原土剪力與整體沉陷仍須分別檢查。~Using average load as column stress understates demand; local column failure transfers force to neighbours and enlarges differential settlement. Here n is a stiffness ratio at corresponding strain, not a strength ratio; column resistance, native-soil shear and overall settlement still require separate checks.
units.misconception: 改良區平均壓力就是每根改良柱承受的壓力。~Mean pressure over the treated area equals pressure in every column.
units.practice: 設計者應明確標示等應變假設與負載轉移層；試驗不支持此假設時，需改用符合實際邊界的互制分析。式中n是相應應變下的剛度比，不是抗壓強度比；柱體承載、原土剪力與整體沉陷仍須分別檢查。~The designer states equal-strain and load-transfer-layer assumptions; if measurements do not support them, use an interaction model consistent with actual boundaries. Here n is a stiffness ratio at corresponding strain, not a strength ratio; column resistance, native-soil shear and overall settlement still require separate checks.

units.title: 鑽孔偏斜的機理與驗證~Bore deviation mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 噴射柱的軸線取決於鑽孔軌跡，深部小偏斜會減少相鄰柱交疊或接近地下資產。名目柱徑不能自動吸收所有偏差，尤其在需閉合止水的底部或轉角；幾何驗證應採實際軌跡而不是只有地面放樣位置。固定偏斜式是線性估算，真實曲線軌跡要逐段積分；偏移方向與相鄰柱相關性比單一絕對值更重要。~The bore trajectory defines the column axis, and small deep deviations can reduce overlap or approach buried assets. Nominal diameter cannot absorb every error, especially near cutoff toes and corners. Geometric verification must therefore use actual trajectories rather than ground-level setting-out positions alone. The constant-inclination formula is linear; curved trajectories require integration, and deviation direction and correlation between adjacent columns matter more than one absolute value.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設深度H=20 m、恆定偏斜比i=0.01，底部偏移δ=Hi=0.20 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For depth H=20 m and constant inclination ratio i=0.01, toe offset δ=Hi=0.20 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 使用核定孔斜方法記錄全深軌跡，將其與管線調查及相鄰柱最小直徑重疊分析。高風險界面需設孔斜查核停留點；地工設計者與資產管理者共同確認所需幾何餘量。~Record full-depth trajectory with an approved deviation method and combine it with utility investigation and minimum adjacent-column diameter. High-risk interfaces require a bore-deviation hold point; the geotechnical designer and asset owner jointly confirm the required geometric reserve.
units.failure: 柱軸朝外偏移會留下改良缺口，朝資產偏移則可能改變周邊土體與既有結構接觸。固定偏斜式是線性估算，真實曲線軌跡要逐段積分；偏移方向與相鄰柱相關性比單一絕對值更重要。~Outward deviation leaves treatment gaps, while deviation toward an asset can alter surrounding ground and its contact with the existing structure. The constant-inclination formula is linear; curved trajectories require integration, and deviation direction and correlation between adjacent columns matter more than one absolute value.
units.misconception: 地面樁位符合容差，就無需再查深部軸線。~Compliant surface position removes the need to check the deep column axis.
units.practice: 高風險界面需設孔斜查核停留點；地工設計者與資產管理者共同確認所需幾何餘量。固定偏斜式是線性估算，真實曲線軌跡要逐段積分；偏移方向與相鄰柱相關性比單一絕對值更重要。~High-risk interfaces require a bore-deviation hold point; the geotechnical designer and asset owner jointly confirm the required geometric reserve. The constant-inclination formula is linear; curved trajectories require integration, and deviation direction and correlation between adjacent columns matter more than one absolute value.

units.title: 強度變異係數的機理與驗證~Strength variability mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 水泥土品質具有空間變異，平均值相同的兩個改良區可能有很不同的低強度尾端。變異係數把標準差相對平均值表達，適合初步比較均勻度，但不能指出缺陷在哪裡；取樣位置及未成芯區會強烈影響統計代表性。變異係數是描述統計，沒有通用合格上限；分層材料或混合族群應分組，不能假設所有試體屬同一常態分布。~Soil-cement quality varies spatially, so areas with the same mean can have different weak tails. Coefficient of variation expresses standard deviation relative to mean and helps compare uniformity, but does not locate defects. Sampling positions and uncoreable intervals strongly affect whether the statistics represent the treated ground. CV is descriptive, without a universal pass threshold; layered or mixed populations require grouping rather than assuming all specimens follow one normal distribution.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設強度平均μ=2.0 MPa、標準差s=0.6 MPa，CV=s/μ=0.30。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For strength mean μ=2.0 MPa and standard deviation s=0.6 MPa, CV=s/μ=0.30. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 依柱號、深度與地層繪製強度分布，同時列樣本數及取芯失敗，不只提供一個平均值。統計判據與弱區補證方法應在取樣前核定；地工設計者依空間模式決定補強，不能只改報表平均值。~Map strength by column, depth and stratum, reporting sample count and core loss together rather than only a mean. Approve statistical criteria and weak-zone verification before sampling; the geotechnical designer selects remedies from spatial patterns rather than adjusting reported averages.
units.failure: 少量高值可能把平均拉高，掩蓋連續低強度帶；刪除取芯失敗會讓變異看似過小。變異係數是描述統計，沒有通用合格上限；分層材料或混合族群應分組，不能假設所有試體屬同一常態分布。~A few high values can raise the mean and hide a continuous weak band; excluding core loss makes variability appear artificially small. CV is descriptive, without a universal pass threshold; layered or mixed populations require grouping rather than assuming all specimens follow one normal distribution.
units.misconception: 平均強度達標就不必理會分布尾端與取樣位置。~Meeting mean strength makes the lower tail and sampling positions irrelevant.
units.practice: 統計判據與弱區補證方法應在取樣前核定；地工設計者依空間模式決定補強，不能只改報表平均值。變異係數是描述統計，沒有通用合格上限；分層材料或混合族群應分組，不能假設所有試體屬同一常態分布。~Approve statistical criteria and weak-zone verification before sampling; the geotechnical designer selects remedies from spatial patterns rather than adjusting reported averages. CV is descriptive, without a universal pass threshold; layered or mixed populations require grouping rather than assuming all specimens follow one normal distribution.

units.title: 水力坡降反算的機理與驗證~Back-calculated gradient mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 完工水力試驗需把流量與水頭及幾何一起解讀，否則低出水可能只因施加水頭小。若已知代表性滲透係數及面積，可由達西式反算坡降，但這是無因次量，不是水頭差；要得到水頭差仍需有效流路長度。反算若同時未知k、面積與流長便不唯一，不能用單一流量解出所有參數；局部缺口需另外檢測定位。~Completion hydraulic tests require flow, head and geometry together, because low discharge may only reflect a low applied head. With representative permeability and area, Darcy flow can infer a dimensionless gradient, not a head difference. An effective flow-path length is still needed to convert that gradient into hydraulic head. Inversion is nonunique when permeability, area and path length are all unknown; one flow cannot determine them all, and local defects require separate location methods.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設Q=1×10⁻⁵ m³/s、k=1×10⁻⁷ m/s、A=100 m²，i=Q/(kA)=1；若另假設L=1 m才有Δh=iL=1 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For Q=1×10⁻⁵ m³/s, k=1×10⁻⁷ m/s and A=100 m², i=Q/(kA)=1; only with additional L=1 m does Δh=iL=1 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 同時記錄試驗流量、上下游水頭及濾管位置，以不同水頭檢查線性，追查短路或邊界漏失。交接水力報告須列公式單位、有效面積及流路假設；地工設計者確認邊界可識別後才接受反算結果。~Record flow, upstream-downstream heads and screen positions together, checking linearity at different heads and investigating bypasses or boundary losses. Handover hydraulic reports state units, effective area and path assumptions; the geotechnical designer accepts inferred properties only after test boundaries are identifiable.
units.failure: 將坡降誤寫成水頭差會漏掉流路長度，錯估止水需求；試驗邊界漏水也可能被誤判為改良體滲透。反算若同時未知k、面積與流長便不唯一，不能用單一流量解出所有參數；局部缺口需另外檢測定位。~Mislabeling gradient as head omits path length and distorts cutoff demand; test-boundary leakage can also be mistaken for treated-ground permeability. Inversion is nonunique when permeability, area and path length are all unknown; one flow cannot determine them all, and local defects require separate location methods.
units.misconception: 流量除以滲透係數與面積，得到的單位就是公尺。~Flow divided by permeability and area has units of metres.
units.practice: 交接水力報告須列公式單位、有效面積及流路假設；地工設計者確認邊界可識別後才接受反算結果。反算若同時未知k、面積與流長便不唯一，不能用單一流量解出所有參數；局部缺口需另外檢測定位。~Handover hydraulic reports state units, effective area and path assumptions; the geotechnical designer accepts inferred properties only after test boundaries are identifiable. Inversion is nonunique when permeability, area and path length are all unknown; one flow cannot determine them all, and local defects require separate location methods.

example: 原創教學例：假設均質改良體滲透係數k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s、面積A=100 m²、水力坡降i=2，流量Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。只把k增加10%至1.1×10⁻⁸ m/s，其他量不變，Q=2.2×10⁻⁶ m³/s，也增加10%。此線性敏感度只對固定幾何與達西流成立；若有貫通缺口，總流量可能由另一機制控制。驗證時要記錄上下游水頭、面積與有效流路，並結合取芯及全深幾何，不能用低流量或高強度單獨宣稱整體止水合格。~Original teaching example: assume homogeneous permeability k=1×10⁻⁸ m/s, area A=100 m² and hydraulic gradient i=2. Darcy discharge is Q=kAi=2×10⁻⁶ m³/s. Increase only k by 10% to 1.1×10⁻⁸ m/s while holding other inputs fixed: Q becomes 2.2×10⁻⁶ m³/s, also up 10%. This linear sensitivity requires fixed geometry and Darcy flow; a connected defect may instead control total discharge through another mechanism. Verification records upstream and downstream heads, area and effective paths, combining cores and full-depth geometry rather than inferring system sealing from low flow or high strength alone. The designer must verify that the test boundaries represent the intended permanent hydraulic condition.
history: 噴射灌漿以高能流體侵蝕並混合原土，形成幾何與材料性質受地層控制的改良體。本課區分止水與承載需求，從滲流、咬合、材料留存及返漿量平衡出發，逐步檢查強度發展、複合地盤分力、鑽孔偏斜和統計變異，最後以水力試驗驗證整體功能。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2017年：美國聯邦公路管理局地盤改良頁列入兩冊地盤改良參考手冊；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。~Jet grouting erodes and mixes soil to form treated bodies whose geometry and properties depend on ground conditions. The course separates cutoff and bearing functions, linking seepage, overlap, binder retention and return balance to strength, composite-ground sharing, bore deviation and variability, then verifies overall performance hydraulically. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2017: FHWA lists the two-volume ground-modification reference manual in its improvement guidance; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.

合成教學假設：假設注入乾膠結材Min=1000 kg、返漿帶出同材Mout=250 kg，留存Mret=Min−Mout=750 kg~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For injected dry binder Min=1000 kg and the same binder recovered in returns Mout=250 kg, retained Mret=750 kg
